title: What is a subject?
goal: Identify the subject in a sentence and notice whether it is singular or plural.

title: Using regular verbs with different subjects
goal: Choose regular verbs that agree with singular and plural subjects.

title: Using be verbs with different subjects
goal: Choose am, is, are, was, and were according to subject and time.

title: Using verb phrases with different subjects
goal: Choose helping verb phrases that agree with singular and plural subjects.

title: What types of nouns do subjects have?
goal: Use noun type and subject number to support subject-verb agreement.

title: Subjects with information before the head noun
goal: Find the head noun when modifiers appear before the subject.

title: Subjects with information after the head noun
goal: Find the head noun when phrases appear after the subject.

title: Subjects with relative clauses
goal: Ignore relative clauses and match the verb to the true subject.

title: Subjects with and / or
goal: Apply agreement rules for compound subjects joined by and or or.
